title: Larger holes for kale is good,  comb not so good!
text:
Larger holes for kale is good, comb not so good!. I have been using a kale stripper for a few years, and thought I would try this oxo kale stripper with a comb also.
This is my 3rd different type of Kale stripper.
The OXO herb comb stripping with different size holes works great for Kale .
But I’m not having much luck with the comb part of this for Thyme, Rosemary, etc. or any other type of Herbs I use.

Actually my original kale stripper has other smaller holes for rosemary etc. and I find that works the best for me.
I’m disapointed with this one!

My 2 star is based on the comb part if this stripper, as I believe that is what is suppose to be different with this Kale stripper.
(Maybe its really a 1 star)..
